LanguageData.APM_Mech_Ravager.label: Ravager
LanguageData.APM_Mech_Ravager.description: The dreaded auto mortar was not enough to sate the mechanoids’ hunger for destruction. Their solution? The ravager, a mobile artillery emplacement. Able to charge excess energy in its reserve power cells, it can temporarily overcharge its cannon and launch a shell that splits into three destructive blasts while still in flight.
